CA.rationale: No C and A bound to the same referent/time found.

COD.rationale: Content (red location) is identified and accompanied by an explicit origin/organization field, and status is separable.

A.rationale: A processing condition ('command_estimate') is explicitly attached to the same candidate content entry.

C.rationale: Text identifies represented content (red) with a location attribute.

D.rationale: Content coordinates and a separate origin/organization field are both present for the same entry.

O.rationale: An explicit origin/organization descriptor indicates how the content is presented/accessed.
